Contract Generator.contract:
Contract LoanProcessingSystemSystem::closeOutLoan(loanid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: Loan = Loan.allInstance()->any(o|o.LoanID = loanid),
		isClosed: Boolean = if obs.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else obs.Status = CLOSED 
		endif 
	precondition:
		Loan.allInstance()->includes(obs) and
		obs.Status = LSOPEN
	postcondition:
		obs.Status = CLOSED and
		result = isClosed
}
